$comment: THE declaration of omx-test-sine-voice, a test plugin: its identity and the constants its face runs with and its oracle predicts from. A voice per held note: sin(2 pi f k / rate) at the key's equal-tempered frequency (A4 = 440 Hz), times gain * velocity, times a linear attack of attackMs and a linear release of releaseMs; at most `voices` sound at once.
name: omx test-sine-voice
description: A test instrument: one sine per held note at its equal-tempered frequency, at a level the velocity predicts, with a linear attack and release.
